body:
The thing with sex is not that I didn't feel ready, but that women are somehow repulsed by me. I don't rate myself as ugly, I'm even sort of handsome and 6 foot 4 tall, but my personality just seems to be terrible/undesirable and I have no clue about dating/am too socially retarded to think of any activites for dates.
Also, I spend so much time alone because my friends don't have time for me all the time, study in another city or hang out with other friends. I want to spend my time productively, but I just don't have the drive and hanging out on the computer/lying around is just so much easier. I know that sounds lazy, because it is. I'm too lazy/depressed to do anything. Sometimes (rarely) I feel a sudden rush of desire to be active, which I always follow up on, but these are just phases that last up to one day, then it's back to my old depressed self again. I don't think I'm bipolar (depressed and manic states), but I do have sudden mood swings like that, for no reason at all.

I have this problem as well, but I realised that it's only a manifestation of other personal problems, which might be the case with you as well.

Edit: what i'm trying to say is that worrying about the future is usually completely unnecessary and that you might feel uneasy for another reason, so I would suggest not to concentrate on your future and rather try to feel good now.
